channel_intelligence.state_of_channel: 98 days in: ~193 videos, 24 subscribers (flat this week), 7,109 lifetime views. This week cooled off the top: 192 views (-15%), 5.3 watch hours (-49%) after last week's 10.4-hour spike. Long-form: 30 views (-19%), 747 impressions (+6%), CTR fell 3.1%->2.0%, AVD fell 19:04->13:46. The Sep 14 breakout ('Chill Bossa Nova... Cozy Autumn Ambience') faded from Suggested exactly as predicted (515->44 impressions), but the pattern held: a brand-new autumn-titled Piano Trio long published Sep 21 ('Soft Jazz Piano Trio - Cozy French Cafe Music for Autumn Mornings') immediately took over as the week's top video (328 impressions, 11 views, 36.7% of the week). A second new autumn Piano Trio long (Sep 24) posted the best watch efficiency of the week: 30:50 average view duration on a 1:31:47 runtime. Suggested videos drove 70% of long-form views and 98.3% of watch hours - more concentrated than ever. The single most important thing: this isn't a Bossa-vs-Piano-Trio story anymore - it's a FRESHNESS story. Every autumn-titled long gets one strong week of Suggested placement right after publish, then fades within 7-10 days. The lever is publish cadence on the winning title formula, not picking a permanent style.
what_works: AUTUMN-TITLED LONGS GET ONE WEEK OF SUGGESTED, THEN FADE - SO KEEP PUBLISHING THEM. Three straight autumn-hook longs (Sep14, Sep17, Sep21) each had their best week the week they published: 515, then normal, then 328 impressions respectively for the newest. The newest long (Sep21) is this week's #1 by views and impressions; the Sep14 one collapsed 515->44 impressions the week after. Confirms last week's finding and adds the timing: the Suggested window is roughly 1 week per video.

SUGGESTED IS NOW 98.3% OF LONG-FORM WATCH TIME. 626 of 747 impressions, 21 of 30 views, 5.0 of 5.1 watch-hours came from Suggested this week (vs RELATED_VIDEO's 79% of minutes last week) - the channel's entire long-form watch time now depends on one distribution channel.

SOFT JAZZ PIANO TRIO AND SOFT BOSSA ARE STATISTICALLY EVEN ON LONGS RIGHT NOW. Piano Trio longs (2 videos): 14 views / 425 impressions / 2.7 watch-hrs. Soft Bossa longs (2 videos): 11 views / 112 impressions / 2.3 watch-hrs. Neither style is the deciding factor this week - recency is.

THE RAINY PARIS CAFE JAZZ LONG (Sep 24) GOT THE BEST WATCH EFFICIENCY EVER LOGGED: 30:50 average view duration on a 91-minute video (33.6% of runtime) - proof the 'Grey Autumn Afternoons' framing pulls a real listening audience, not just a click.

QUIET LIBRARY CAFE BOSSA NOVA (Sep 17) HAS THE BEST CTR OF THE WEEK AT 5.9%, nearly 3x the channel's 2.0% long-form average, on a modest 68 impressions - a title/thumbnail worth reusing even though its distribution was small.
next_moves: KEEP THE AUTUMN LONG CADENCE GOING WEEKLY - DO NOT LET IT LAPSE. The pattern is now 3 videos deep: freshness, not style, earns the Suggested week. Every Mon/Thu long needs an autumn-season title in the 'Cozy Autumn <Ambience/Jazz> for <Slow Days/Grey Afternoons/Calm Days>' shape before it goes live, alternating Piano Trio and Bossa is fine since both perform the same.

THE PIANO TRIO SWAP DID NOT RESCUE SHORTS - INVESTIGATE THE REAL VARIABLE. Social clips were swapped back to Piano Trio/Soft Jazz sourcing per last week's recommendation, but YouTube Shorts views kept falling (205 -> 152, -26%), missing the predicted recovery to 400+. Either the earlier 'Fun Bossa halved Shorts' read was confounded by something else (seasonal drop-off, algorithm change, novelty fatigue on this content type generally), or two data points isn't enough. Do not declare Piano Trio the winner again until a week actually recovers toward 400.

TIKTOK IS NOW THE BIGGEST SOCIAL LEVER, NOT INSTAGRAM. First week with real per-post view data: TikTok did 2,000 views / 61 likes / 3.25% ER across 13 posts vs Instagram's 507 views / 17 likes / 3.75% ER across 13 posts. TikTok also drove the follower growth (+1 to 70) alongside Instagram (+1 to 43). Shift creative energy and caption testing toward TikTok first.

RETITLE THE NEXT SOFT BOSSA LONG USING THE QUIET LIBRARY CTR PATTERN. 5.9% CTR beat the Piano Trio long's 1.8% by more than 3x on the same 'Cozy Autumn' formula - test whether 'Library'/'Calm Days' framing out-clicks 'French Cafe'/'Morning' framing on the next few thumbnails.

channel_intelligence.suno_rules: Data-backed prompt rules, updated 2026-09-28: (1) ALWAYS 'instrumental / no vocals'. (2) KEEP ENERGY CONSISTENT, no dynamic spikes - Suggested is now 98.3% of long-form watch hours and those sessions end the moment a track jumps. (3) SEASON THE TITLE AND PROMPT TOGETHER - three straight autumn-titled longs each got a distribution week right after publish; write the season into the mood ('cozy autumn cafe', 'rainy grey afternoon', 'quiet library autumn') so audio and title match. (4) NEW - PUBLISH CADENCE BEATS STYLE LOYALTY. Piano Trio and Soft Bossa longs performed statistically even this week (14 views/425 impr vs 11 views/112 impr); the real driver is how recently the video published. Alternate styles freely as long as a new autumn-hook long goes out every Mon/Thu. (5) HIGH-CTR TITLE PATTERN WORTH TESTING - 'Quiet Library...Cozy Autumn Jazz for Calm Days' pulled 5.9% CTR, 3x the channel average; try 'Library'/'Calm Days' framing on more thumbnails. (6) VARY RUNTIME 75-120 MINUTES on longs rather than defaulting to one fixed length; the 91-minute Rainy Paris long logged a 30:50 AVD (33.6% of runtime), the best watch efficiency yet. (7) NAME THE ACTION AND MATCH SEARCH - search volume is thin (4 views this week) so don't over-index on query wording; Suggested placement matters far more right now. (8) STILL WITHDRAWN - caption rules; captions remain noise on 6+ weeks of data.
